components.name: MagicBento
components.finding: Responsive dense bento feature grid with light/dark rounded surfaces, pointer glow, optional stars/tilt/magnetism and linked or button cards. Built-in visuals are decorative simulations, not dashboards/services. 4/2/1 columns measured by ResizeObserver; text is clamped.

components.motion: Native RAF springs/light/canvas plus CSS keyframes; entrance at 15% intersection; pointer and click replay; optional star loop and hover cursors/packets; no scroll-progress transform. Reduced-motion checked only at mount suppresses intro, tilt, magnetism, stars and wave; light easing and CSS color/switch transitions remain. disableAnimations captured in mount closure; runtime changes need review.
